div.p: Each role is a single position on three axes: substance · anchor · modality.

Substance — new (brings its own) vs carried (holds what exists). Anchor — sc (the SC's head) / material (codebase or fleet state) / decided (already settled). Modality — prose (the conversation) vs tool (a file or artefact).
Operators are left off for now — these are the roles the SC works with directly.
